data.title: Loss carryforward notice for 2025 (Verlustvortrag)
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterbergen issued a notice dated 25 January 2027 fixing the remaining income tax loss carryforward as of 31 December 2025 at €4,806.00. It stems from your Master's studies costs.
data.explanation: The tax office has officially determined that €4,806.00 of losses from your Master's studies (advance income-related expenses, vorweggenommene Werbungskosten) carries forward. It will be offset against your future positive income, reducing future tax. No payment is requested. If you think the amount is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or on record at the issuing office. The app shows the deadline. Keep this notice for future tax returns; a tax adviser can help if unsure.
data.tax_note: Fixes the loss carryforward from Master's studies costs that will reduce future taxable income.
